title: Extend rust_boxed_errors with write, max_line, sum_numbers, and email validation
description: Brownfield Rust task: add five new utility functions to the boxed-errors library alongside the existing four.

task_spec.prompt:
Add five new functions to src/lib.rs. All 7 existing tests must still pass.

  pub fn write_file(path: &Path, content: &str) -> AppResult<()>
    — write content to path, creating or truncating the file

  pub fn max_line(path: &Path) -> AppResult<i64>
    — read file, parse each non-empty line as i64, return the maximum value
    — return Err if the file is empty, unreadable, or any line fails to parse

  pub fn sum_numbers(s: &str) -> AppResult<i64>
    — split s by ',' and parse each trimmed token as i64, return the sum
    — return Err if s is empty (after trimming) or any token fails to parse

  pub fn count_valid_usernames(names: &[&str]) -> usize
    — count how many names in the slice pass validate_username; does not return Err

  pub fn validate_email(email: &str) -> AppResult<()>
    — return Ok if email contains '@' and the part after '@' contains '.'
    — otherwise return Err with a descriptive message

Do not modify the existing functions or tests.
Add tests for all 5 new functions.
All 7 existing tests must still pass.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: write_file creates or truncates the file at path
max_line returns max parsed integer from file lines
sum_numbers parses comma-separated integers and returns their sum
count_valid_usernames counts names that pass validate_username
validate_email accepts valid emails, rejects missing @ or missing domain dot
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `cargo test` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `cargo test` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
